paper.title: Linear Stochastic Bandits Under Safety Constraints

settings.name_in_paper: Safe linear stochastic bandit problem (known positive safety gap)
unmapped: Linear safety constraint mu^T B x <= c with known B and c>0, must hold at every round w.h.p.; regret measured against best safe action
Learner knows the safety gap Delta = c - mu^T B x* > 0 (or a lower bound on it)
Learner knows lambda_- = lambda_min of covariance of uniform distribution on the conservative safe set D^w
Decision set D_0 is a convex body containing the origin in its interior
settings.definition_quote: Ensure that a linear side constraint of the form $\mu^\dagger B x \leq c$ is respected at every round during the $T$-period run of the algorithm, where $B$ and $c$ are known.

settings.name_in_paper: Safe linear stochastic bandit problem (general / safety gap possibly zero)
unmapped: Linear safety constraint mu^T B x <= c with known B and c>0, must hold at every round w.h.p.; regret measured against best safe action
Learner knows lambda_- = lambda_min of covariance of uniform distribution on the conservative safe set D^w
Decision set D_0 is a convex body containing the origin in its interior
settings.definition_quote: In this paper, we assume that $\Ds(\mu)$ is defined via a linear constraint $\mu^\dagger B x_t \leq c$, which needs to be satisfied by $x_t$ at all rounds $t$ with high probability.

source.label: thm:regretdeltanotzero
source.quote: Let the same assumptions as in Lemma \ref{lem:x^*in} hold. Initialize \SUCB~with $T'\geq T_\Delta$ specified in \eqref{eq:T0}. Then, for $T\geq T'$, with probability at least $1-2\delta$, the cumulative regret of \SUCB~satisfies R_T\leq 2T'+2\beta_T\sqrt{2d \,(T-T') \,\log \left(\frac{2TL^2}{d(\lambda_-T'+2\la)}\right)}. Specifically, choosing $T'=T_{\Delta}$ guarantees cumulant regret $\Oc(T^{1/2}\log{T})$.

results.notes: Holds w.p. >= 1-2delta; regret is sum of mean losses vs best safe action (pseudo-regret on a high-probability event). Proof assumes beta_T > 1 for simplicity.

results.notes: Holds for any safety gap including Delta = 0; probability >= 1-2delta.
